content.thinking: Interesting: with the key A installed via a keys event it gave FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR, but here without a key it gives NO_KEY. Let me add the keys event to the debug.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='submission/src/offline/dbg.java'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("    Main.Event e=new Main.Event(); e.wire","    Main.Event k=new Main.Event(); k.keys=new java.util.ArrayList<>(); k.keys.add(\"A\"); t.events.add(k);\n    Main.Event e=new Main.Event(); e.wire")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
python3 build.py submission/src tmp/classes 2>&1|head -5; /opt/java/bin/java -cp tmp/classes offline.dbg 2>&1 | head -2
